# Coalesce draft saves in the workspace

The editor currently writes to the workspace store on every edit. Change editor
autosave to coalesce a burst of input: after 120 ms without another edit, save
only its latest text. Reuse the existing trailing-task utility where appropriate.
Preserve the workspace's existing navigation and persistence behavior. Keep
search preview behavior unchanged; its timing is outside this maintenance task.

limitations: Departure flushing is a preservation strategy derived from TASK and the original immediate-write behavior; persistent ownership alone does not establish a universal before-return persistence deadline.
Only attempt 1 is supplied. Its syntax checks and acceptance verdict passed; no supplied behavioral observations establish causality or cross-task benefit.

rules.body: Apply when reusable document buffers, visit subscriptions and navigation projection have separate lifetimes, and saving can synchronously navigate. README.md states: "Document body, per-document buffer and navigation outline are separate responsibilities." It also states: "Workspace coordinates visits; saved integrations may synchronously navigate and outline retains a breadcrumb archive." src/coordinator.js creates "const bank=new BufferBank();" and returns existing buffers with "return this.entries.get(id);".

Capture the current view when accepting an edit and enqueue text in that view's buffer. Preserve the no-current-view no-op, original document association and reusable per-document buffers. TASK states: "autosave to coalesce a burst of input: after 120 ms without another edit, save\nonly its latest text. Reuse the existing trailing-task utility where appropriate." src/coordinator.js binds each buffer consumer with "trailing(env.timers,120,text=>env.store.write(id,text))". Do not defer document selection until consumption.

Snapshot and retire consumed pending state before invoking callback-capable saving. Preserve src/services.js: "const flush = () => { const saved = value; retire(); if (saved !== null) consume(saved); };" This permits empty-string saving, prevents nested flushing from consuming the same value again and lets edits accepted during consumption establish a subsequent burst.

Capture the departing view, revoke current ownership, detach its captured subscription and finish its clearing presentation before flushing its buffer. Retain the reusable buffer. TASK states: "Preserve the workspace's existing navigation and persistence behavior." The original src/coordinator.js edit path is "edit(text){const view=getView();if(view){env.store.write(view.id,text);}}". Flushing departing text preserves store availability for destination reads, including same-document reopening, and persistence through ordinary close and dispose. After retirement can save and navigate, recheck the open request before installing its destination; the original source already contains "const mine=++request;retire();if(true&&mine!==request)return;".

Validate enclosing coordinator authority after callback-capable editor navigation before committing or clearing projection. Guard both select and close so nested navigation retains its document, selection and projection, and a superseded requested visit does not enter the breadcrumb archive. src/coordinator.js already captures "const mine=++epoch,v=++visit;editor.open(id,v);" and "const mine=++epoch;editor.close();". src/navigation-projection.js states: "// decides whether a requested visit was retained before committing it here." A coordinator dispose guard may protect its projection effect, but complete workspace-disposal precedence remains unspecified.

Preserve document and visit identities, status filtering, subscription removal, store event semantics and copied breadcrumb history. src/coordinator.js filters with "if(event.id===id)env.renderStatus(event);" and renders "env.renderDocument({id,visit,text:env.store.read(id)});". src/services.js writes "records.set(id, text);" before creating "const event = {id, text, revision: ++revision};" and notifying still-subscribed listeners. src/navigation-projection.js publishes "renderProjection({ selected: selected && { ...selected }, trail: trail.map(item => ({ ...item })) });" and clears through "clear() { selected = null; publish(); },". Preserve workspace cleanup in src/workspace.js: "dispose(){api.dispose();node.off('.scope');node.removeData('view');}".

Determine departure scheduling from TASK and existing persistence behavior separately from buffer ownership. Do not discard accepted document edits merely because their visit subscription retires. Keep transient preview policy separate: TASK states "search preview behavior unchanged; its timing is outside this maintenance task." Preserve src/services.js: "const task = trailing(timers, 40, query => publish({query}));" and "return {query: text => task.push(text), hide: () => task.cancel()};". Do not import mutable-text copying, Vue teardown, decoding or audit requirements from related experiences without current public evidence.

Check latest-only saving after 120 ms of quiet, interval resetting, subsequent bursts, empty strings and editing with no current view. Exercise pending edits across switch, same-document reopen, close and dispose; check original-document persistence, destination reads, independent buffer reuse and captured subscription cleanup. Trigger nested select and close from timer-driven and departure-driven saves; check final selection, document/projection visit agreement, absence of superseded breadcrumbs and survival of subsequent nested edits without duplicate consumption. Check copied breadcrumb payloads and trail retention after ordinary clearing. Confirm workspace event routing and disposal cleanup, and preview's unchanged 40 ms delay and hide cancellation. These are source-derived verification recommendations, not claims of observed behavioral coverage.

rules.body: Apply when per-document pending work survives presentation retirement and saving can synchronously navigate. Capture the current view and enqueue an acceptance-time copy of its text in that view's document buffer. Preserve the no-current-view no-op and original document association. Existing src/workflow.rb immediately copies stored text with "@records[id] = text.dup.freeze"; deferring that copy until consumption would allow caller mutation to change accepted text. Keep separate reusable buffers rather than redirecting pending text through the later current view.

Retire consumed pending state before invoking callback-capable work so nested flushing cannot duplicate it and nested edits can establish another burst. Preserve src/workflow.rb ordering: "value = @pending\n    @handle = @pending = nil\n    @work.call(value) unless value.nil?". Empty text must remain consumable.
